# TPC-DS-OBT Q19

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT item_i_brand_id AS brand_id, item_i_brand AS brand, item_i_manufact_id, item_i_manufact, SUM(ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (sold_date_d_date_sk = sold_date_sk AND item_sk = item_i_item_sk AND item_i_manager_id = 2 AND sold_date_d_moy = 11 AND sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND ship_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk AND bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk AND SUBSTRING(bill_addr_ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) <> SUBSTRING(store_s_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) AND store_sk = store_s_store_sk) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY item_i_brand, item_i_brand_id, item_i_manufact_id, item_i_manufact ORDER BY ext_price DESC, item_i_brand, item_i_brand_id, item_i_manufact_id, item_i_manufact LIMIT 100
```
